about: Known failures of the real-bug test and the metamorphic test (ADR-0117 §4). Each entry is a failure that an open issue reproduces. The test fails on a failure that is not listed and on an entry that no longer fails; scripts/ci/known_failures.py fails when the issue is closed or when the pull request closes it while the entry stands. Fields: check (real-bug or a rewrite id), design (corpus id), relation (expect, test, codes, safety, location, hardware), issue (number), reason.
